A '''village''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Datar/Legends|Datar]] was home to many [[Ghostling]] inhabitants, including [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Arawynne]].<ref name="TGC 1">''[[Episode I Adventures 5: The Ghostling Children]]'', Chapter 1</ref> In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Kitster DB">{{DB|character|kitster|Banai, Kitster}}</ref> the [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Djas Puhr/Legends|Djas Puhr]] and his [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin]] sidekick [[Gondry]] raided the village and kidnapped several Ghostling [[Youngling/Legends|children]], incuding Arawynne,<ref name="TGC 1" /> [[Alamar]], [[Borofir]], [[Conno]],<ref name="TGC 6">''[[Episode I Adventures 5: The Ghostling Children]]'', Chapter 6</ref> and [[Coniel]].<ref name="TOT 10">''[[Episode I Adventures 8: Trouble on Tatooine]]'', Chapter 10</ref> The invaders were working for the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer]] [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]], who intended to sell the Ghostlings on the [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] market.<ref name="TGC 1" />
